bugs.description: Reservation now validates and decrements each stock line in one loop, so a later invalid line throws after earlier inventory has already been consumed.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: A multi-line reservation has an earlier satisfiable line followed by an unknown or insufficient-stock line.
bugs.observableImpact: The reservation fails but earlier stock remains decremented, creating an unowned inventory hold.
bugs.provenance: Seeded from a base implementation that validated every line before a second mutation pass. Confirmed by curator-only executable proof.
